validator_formula: row=max(declared_height, max_cell(top+bottom+sum(estimated_lines*font_size*line_spacing)+max(0.07in,0.14*line_height))); table_bottom=y+sum(row). Line spacing percent lower-bounded1; absent default1.2. Shrinking declared row height alone does not reduce text minimum.
warning_vs_failure: Native table is warning, 7 font findings cause actual failure. Both handled without changing validators.
watermark_provenance: ROOT reports original cropped decorative watermarks; require original-slide12 to new-slide13 geometry and visual proof before accepting unchanged warnings.
